subject.title: feat: add Pioneer.ai as an inference provider with live model discovery

question: Should OpenClaw accept Pioneer as an official provider after the custom-base catalog bug is fixed and the dependency graph changes are approved or regenerated?
rationale: The remaining choice combines official provider ownership, supply-chain/release approval, and user-facing model-picker live discovery behavior that automation should not decide permanently.

options.title: Fix and approve official provider
options.body: Repair the custom-base augmentation bug, resolve the dependency/security gate, and record maintainer acceptance of Pioneer as official before merge.

options.title: Route externally first
options.body: Ask the contributor to publish Pioneer as a self-maintained ClawHub/npm provider and split only generic external-provider catalog fixes into OpenClaw core.

options.title: Accept as-is intentionally
options.body: Maintainers could explicitly own the official provider, dependency graph, and live-discovery tradeoffs despite the current upgrade/security risks.

recommendation.title: Fix and approve official provider
recommendation.body: Repair the custom-base augmentation bug, resolve the dependency/security gate, and record maintainer acceptance of Pioneer as official before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about official provider/product acceptance plus security-gated release surfaces, and steipete is the best available project-level routing owner from the inspected history and CONTRIBUTING.md.
